findings.evidence: Originally the floating toggle covered the exercise footer's Previous/Skip/Next buttons. Now `.chat-toggle` is a vertical tab on the right edge with a 44px gutter reserved while the panel is closed; at <=960px it is a pill at bottom 96px above the sticky footer.
findings.why_it_matters: The toggle must not hide the primary exercise navigation.
findings.resolution: Fixed and checked in a browser at 1280x800 and 375x812 with a temporary mock page (since deleted).

findings.evidence: Originally a failed latest-session load dispatched `loaded` with a client-minted session id. Now the catch only dispatches sendFailed; loaded stays false, composer and New chat stay locked, ChatPanel shows a Try again button.
findings.why_it_matters: 'Server has no conversation' and 'server unreachable' must stay distinct, otherwise a fresh id silently replaces the student's real latest session.
findings.resolution: Fixed; verified in the browser (load failure keeps the input disabled and shows the retry button).

findings.evidence: Clickable error paragraph, no focus management, no Escape handling, live region missing in the empty state.
findings.why_it_matters: Keyboard and screen-reader students could not reach or hear the controls and state changes.
findings.resolution: Removed the click handler, focus the input on open and after each answer, Escape closes, focus returns to the toggle, role=log in both list states. Dialog semantics for the narrow overlay are tracked in QUAL-008.

findings.evidence: The notice stayed on 'Resets in 0h 0m' after the reset time because nothing re-read the quota.
findings.why_it_matters: A locked composer with a dead-end message after the quota day rolled over.
findings.resolution: ChatQuotaNotice calls onExpired once when the clock passes resetAt; ChatPanel passes refresh.

findings.evidence: CHAT_MAX_INPUT_CHARS = 1000 and the 23-entry CHAT_TASK_TYPES list are hand-copied from the server (limit is configurable via chat.ai.max-input-chars).
findings.why_it_matters: The backend re-validates, so this is UX-only; drift shows up as CHAT_INVALID_REQUEST or a client limit differing from a changed server limit.
findings.required_action: None for this phase. Update both places in one change if the server enum or limit changes.

findings.evidence: Wire names (camelCase fields, 429 data {resetAt, limit, remaining}) match the Phase 3 contract, but the Phase 3 controller was not finished when this was reviewed.
findings.why_it_matters: A name mismatch would surface only at runtime as CHAT_INVALID_RESPONSE.
findings.required_action: Verify the real HTTP responses end to end in Phase 5.

findings.evidence: Pure functions, the reducer, contracts, api, CSS text and markdown static markup are tested; hooks and panel components have no tests because Vitest runs in node without testing-library.
findings.why_it_matters: The send orchestration relies on the reducer and composer-state tests plus manual verification.
findings.required_action: None required. Optionally extract the Enter-key predicate as a pure function and test the load-failure branch.
findings.resolution: Accepted for this environment; the behaviour was exercised manually in a browser.

findings.evidence: At <=960px the panel is position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1000 but the aside has no role=dialog/aria-modal, no focus trap and no scroll lock.
findings.why_it_matters: On narrow screens keyboard and screen-reader users can tab to the page behind the overlay.
findings.required_action: Accepted debt. Add dialog semantics and a focus trap if narrow-screen accessibility is prioritised.

findings.evidence: (1) The load-failure path reuses the sendFailed action name. (2) The mobile pill's bottom: 96px is coupled to the footer height without a named token. (3) With a client clock ahead of the server, a refresh that returns a resetAt still in the client's past leaves the stale '0h 0m' notice until the panel is reopened.
findings.why_it_matters: All low-impact: a misleading action name, a magic offset and a rare clock-skew dead end.
findings.required_action: Optional: rename the action to requestFailed, tie the offset to a footer variable, clamp the notice to a refreshing state.
